audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer is built around an ability that does not exist. "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" appears eleven times — focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading twice, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[2].d, report[1].t, report[3].t, report[5].t and report[9].t. Hwei's E is Subject: Torment. Separately, the content layer calls Spiraling Despair a fear in three places (spikes[1].text, mid, wants.foe[1]) — his R is not a fear at all — and wants.foe[0] cites "Grim Portrait", which is not one of his abilities.
audit.why: Riot's E text: Subject: Torment replaces his abilities with crowd control abilities — Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw. Riot's R text: the first enemy champion struck becomes the centre of an expanding painting that slows and damages nearby enemies, exploding at max size or when that champion dies. A reader tracking "Subject: Fear" is tracking nothing, and a reader expecting to be feared by the ultimate will position for the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: Every instance renamed to Subject: Torment with its real 12s palette cooldown; Spiraling Despair re-described as a 1300-range expanding zone centred on the first champion it strikes; "Grim Portrait" removed.
sources: hwei kit R text and range 1300

audit.whatIsWrong: Signature of the Visionary is never mentioned anywhere on either layer, and neither is the Subject: Serenity shield.
audit.why: His passive primes an enemy champion on the first damaging spell and COMPLETES on the second, dropping a signature that detonates after a short delay for area damage. That single mechanic is the whole shape of trading against him: one contact is chip, two is a burst, so breaking off after one spell is the entire discipline. The brief separately flags shield-absorbs-burst on Subject: Serenity — a shield that eats the opening of any commit you make.
audit.corrected: Prime-then-detonate now carried through tldr, winCon, enemyWin, both trade strings, dos/donts, early, feeding and carry; the Serenity shield added to breakdown.cooldowns and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 1 contradict across layers — content win[0] and win[1] read "Hwei" (matching the packet chart) while full phases[0].side and phases[1].side read "Skill". Five further rows read "Skill" against content "Aurora". Six content fields also claim Aurora's E is a gap-closer that flips the lane at 3: whys[1] ("With E now online you can dash past his safe range"), spikes[0], mid and early ("without your E unlocked yet you have no way to close the distance").
audit.why: Levels 1-2 are Hwei's and the kit says why: his Q palette pokes from range and Aurora has W only at 2 and E only at 3. But Aurora's E is not a gap-closer — Riot's text is a blast that damages and slows, after which she HOPS BACKWARD. Her entrance is W. The page's whole early-to-mid narrative is built on the wrong button.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side flipped to Hwei to match win[0]/win[1], with both whys rewritten and ratings moved in the same proposal. E corrected to a slow-and-backhop everywhere, W named as the entrance. Rows 2-6 LEFT ALONE — see notes.
sources: aurora kit E and W text

audit.whatIsWrong: "Canvas terrain" and "canvas zone control" are treated as real mechanics in five fields — whys[5], spikes[3].text, late, wants.you[2] and wants.foe[2] — and three of them add that Between Worlds "phases through" it.
audit.why: Nothing in any of Hwei's four ability descriptions creates terrain. His zoning is damage placed on the ground. And Aurora's R is a leap with a slowing zone and a cross-zone teleport — it has no phasing and nothing to pass through.
audit.corrected: Removed and replaced with the real positional counterplay to Spiraling Despair: do not be the first champion in its path, and do not stand beside whoever is.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit, and the page repeatedly refers to "his long cooldowns" without ever giving one.
audit.why: Subject: Torment is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, Subject: Disaster 10/9/8/7/6, Subject: Serenity 18/17.5/17/16.5/16, Spiraling Despair 120/100/80. His palettes are short, not long — calling them long teaches the reader to wait for a window that is already back.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into cooldowns, winCon, loading, ahead, dosFull[2], report[5] and report[9].

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad pasted, dosFull[0].d was breakdown.cooldowns pasted, and dontsFull[0].d said "deny it and THEY run out of answers" about a single champion.

audit.corrected: Each body rewritten against its own title, with Hwei referred to as he.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[10].t claimed "Your E knockback-slow is clean gank setup", and phases[3].why claimed "three-spell spirit stacks proc your passive haste".
audit.why: Aurora's E has no knockback, and her passive heals rather than granting haste.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten on what the abilities actually do.

notes: ALL THREE PACKET SUSPECTNAMES ARE FALSE POSITIVES on the name itself — spikes[1], wants.foe[1] and mid all spell "Spiraling Despair" correctly. The actual defect in those three strings is that they call the ultimate a FEAR; it is an expanding slow-and-damage zone centred on the first champion struck. The detector missed the eleven genuine fabrications of "Subject: Fear (CC Paints)" in the full layer, which is not an ability at all. FOCUS.TEXT: changed to "Hwei Subject: Torment (CC Paints)" rather than plain "Hwei Subject: Torment" specifically to stay inside the +/-10% length band — the shorter, cleaner name is a 30 percent cut and would be rejected. If focus.text is exempt from the band, the better value is "Hwei Subject: Torment". FIVE CHART ROWS LEFT ALONE: phases[2..6].side read "Skill" while content win[2..6] read "Aurora". I flipped only rows 0-1, where the two layers disagree and the kit settles it. Rows 2-6 I cannot settle: content and packet both say Aurora owns five of seven rows, but the win rate is 48.57% over 1435 games, which points the other way, and the page's own diff says EVEN. DIFF: EVEN at 5.5/10 against a 48.57% win rate is arguably a touch generous, but moving diff means moving diffRating, carryRating, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t together, and the kits give me no basis for a specific new number. UNVERIFIED AND NOT WRITTEN: which specific Torment paint is the fear, root or knock-up (Riot's palette text names Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss and Crushing Maw without saying which does what), whether the sub-abilities have their own cooldowns separate from the 12s palette, whether Aurora's W invisibility prevents the signature from completing, and whether Spiraling Despair can re-centre if its host dies early.
